{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) file-message plugin: Claude-style drag-and-drop / paperclip upload, content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (with built-in JS fallback), text inlining, read_document tool for agents.","id":"gh:1334921369","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-file-upload","slug":"HongMing-Huang/dsh-file-upload","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) file-message plugin: Claude-style drag-and-drop / paperclip upload, content s"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"niffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (with built-in JS fallback), text inlining, r"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ead_document tool for agents."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-file-upload"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**File-message plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).** Claude/Codex-style uploads — drag-and-drop (file"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"s and folders), paperclip picker, paste-to-attach, multi-file support; content sniffing; fully bundl"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ed document → Markdown conversion (MarkItDown engine, 20+ formats, image OCR); Codex-style `@relativ"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"e/path` references; automatic image explanations for text-only models; and a `read_document` tool fo"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"eferences; automatic image explanations for text-only models; and a `read_document` tool for agents."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Zero-config, install-and-use.** Every feature works out of the box with
> sensible defaults — no"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" Python, no downloads, no picking backends. Image
> explanations auto-discover a vision endpoint (lo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"cal Ollama → OpenAI-compatible
> key from the dsh credentials seam)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Upload** — composer paperclip button plus a global drag-and-drop overlay ("release to attach"), "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"multi-file support.

- **Codex-style file references"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"** — uploaded files appear in the message as `@relative/path` references (like OpenAI Codex), never "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"as raw content dumped into the composer; the agent reads the file with `read_document` (converted to"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" Markdown on demand).
- **Codex-style `@` mentions** — type `@` in the composer to pick any uploaded"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" file by its relative path; the reference inserts as a mention.
- **Document → Markdown, fully bundl"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ed** — the MarkItDown engine ships inside the plugin (Microsoft MarkItDown TypeScript port, `markitd"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"own-node`): PDF / DOCX / PPTX / XLSX / HTML / CSV / JSON / XML / RSS / Atom / ZIP / Jupyter / image "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"OCR / audio transcription. **No Python, no downloads, no setup.**
- **Image explanation for text-onl"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"y models** — upload an image and the plugin automatically generates a **description ("讲解图片")** throu"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"gh a vision discovery chain, so the DeepSeek API (text-only) can reason about the image: explicit `v"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"isionEndpoint` → local Ollama with a VL model (e.g. DeepSeek-VL2, zero-config) → OpenAI-compatible e"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"ndpoint with a dsh-credentials key. Multimodal routes / vision bridges keep the official `read_image"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"` path.
- **`read_document` tool for agents** — line-numbered paging (`offset`/`limit`), byte-budget"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"ed LRU cache (invalidated on file change), size pre-checks, reads through `ctx.fs` (inherits sandbox"},{"id":"p7s17","text":" and fs-observation policy).
- **Security** — loopback-only uploads, sanitized file names, session-i"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"solated storage (`.dsh-uploads/<sessionId>`), sha256 content dedup, bounded concurrency, TTL sweep."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. The agent reads documents with `read_document <path>` — converted to Markdown on dem"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"and, pageable with `offset`/`limit`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### MarkItDown (fully bundled — no downloads, no setup)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**The MarkItDown capability ships inside the plugin. Codex-style `@relative/path"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"` reference (the raw content and absolute host
paths never appear in the chat). Images additionally "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"get **content support**
based on what your session's model can do, detected at upload time:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Detected route | What happens |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| **Multimodal model** (declares `image` input, e.g. GPT-4o / Qwen-VL / Claude / Gemini) | the `@ref"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"erence` is inserted; the agent calls the `read_image` tool and the image enters model context direct"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ly |
